h: Trump reportedly compliments Nicki Minaj's looks at a Michigan rally, drawing mixed reactions
p: A video said to be from a Michigan rally shows the US president making a remark about the rapper's appearance. Social media users have reacted with a mix of amusement and criticism. Minaj has been a vocal supporter of Trump this year.
more: Minaj called herself his "number one fan" at an event in January.
The clip has spread widely on social media.
